annotations.title: Find pre-seed and seed startup pitches for deal flow on PitchSpark

description: Find early-stage startups to invest in: search scored pre-seed and seed pitches on PitchSpark in plain English (e.g. "pre-seed fintech in Europe raising under $2M"), filtered by sector, stage, region, raise size, traction, green flags or score. Deal flow for angel deals: each Spark Card has the ask, stage, sector, region, one-line description, traction, green flags, pitchspark_score and a link to the full pitch. Only pitches approved for listing are returned. pitchspark_score is PitchSpark's AI pitch score (0-100, shown at 70+, else null); founder claims are self-reported. Keyword matching, not semantic. No key needed for 10 pitches a day.

green_flags.description: Pitches showing any of these founder-chosen flags, e.g. "Previous exit", "Profitable", "Signed LOI". Up to 10.

has_traction.description: true: only pitches with a public traction summary.

include_seen.description: true: also return pitches already shown to this caller in the last 7 days; the pitches returned are then not recorded.

limit.description: How many pitches to return. Default and maximum 10, or up to 25 with a Pro key.

location.description: HQ region, or a list: us, canada, latam, uk, europe, mea, apac, global_remote. Some country names are accepted. For a US state or city, put it in the query.

max_raise_usd.description: Maximum raise in US dollars, e.g. 2000000. Only pitches with a disclosed raise match.

min_raise_usd.description: Minimum raise in US dollars, e.g. 500000. Only pitches with a disclosed raise match.

min_score.description: Minimum pitchspark_score (0 to 100), e.g. 80. Scores are published from 70, so lower values act as 70 and unscored pitches are left out.

query.description: The investor's request in plain English, e.g. "seed climate startups in Europe raising under $3M, not hardware". Sector, stage, place, raise, score and traction cues in it are applied as filters; "not X" excludes and "top scoring" sorts by score.

sector.description: Sector, or a list of up to 10, e.g. "fintech". Keys: fintech, healthtech, saas, marketplace, ai_ml, consumer, enterprise, climate, edtech, crypto, biotech, hardware, gaming, real_estate, food_beverage, fashion, travel, sports, media, femtech, cybersecurity, dev_tools, ecommerce, logistics, mobility, hr_tech, legal_tech, insurtech, proptech, agtech, energy, robotics, govtech, hospitality, other. Common names like "AI" or "climate tech" work.

stage.description: Funding stage, or a list, e.g. "seed" or ["pre_seed", "seed"].

name: pitchspark_search_pitches_v1

error.description: Present only when the call failed (isError true).

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. RATE_LIMITED, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, INVALID_ARGUMENT, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, PITCH_LIMIT_REACHED, INTERNAL.

message.description: A short human-readable explanation, safe to show the user. Never a stack trace.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, when waiting helps.

retryable.description: true when the same call can succeed later without changes.

interpretation.description: How the request was read: caller-derived values only (filters, relaxed filters, seen_excluded).

pitchspark_score.description: PitchSpark's AI pitch score, 0 to 100, published only at 70 or above; null when not published.

truncated.description: true when pitches were left off to keep the reply under the size cap.

title: Find pre-seed and seed startup pitches for deal flow on PitchSpark
